table.name: alignment
table.purpose: Lookup table of superhero moral alignments (Good, Bad, Neutral, N/A), referenced by the superhero table.

alignment.name: alignment_label
alignment.description: Moral alignment category of a superhero: Good, Bad, Neutral, or N/A (unknown/not applicable).

id.name: alignment_id
id.description: Primary key of the alignment lookup table; referenced by superhero.alignment_id to assign each hero an alignment.

table.name: attribute
table.purpose: Lookup table of superhero ability attributes (e.g. Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power, Combat) used to score superheroes via hero_attribute.

attribute_name.name: attribute_name
attribute_name.description: Name of the ability attribute (e.g. Intelligence, Speed, Durability, Power, Combat).

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; referenced by hero_attribute.attribute_id to link heroes to their attribute scores.

table.name: colour
table.purpose: Lookup table of colour names used to describe superheroes' eye, skin, and hair colours. Referenced by the superhero table via eye_colour_id, skin_colour_id, and hair_colour_id foreign keys.

colour.name: colour_name
colour.description: Human-readable colour name (e.g., Black, Amber, Strawberry Blond, Silver). Includes compound values like 'Black/Blue' and 'Brown/Black', consistent with describing hair/eye/skin colours. Each of the 35 rows has a unique colour name.

id.name: colour_id
id.description: Primary key of the colour lookup table; surrogate integer identifier (1-35) referenced by superhero.eye_colour_id, superhero.skin_colour_id, and superhero.hair_colour_id.

table.name: gender
table.purpose: Lookup table of gender categories for superheroes (Male, Female, N/A), referenced by the superhero table via gender_id.

gender.name: gender_label
gender.description: Human-readable gender label: 'Male', 'Female', or 'N/A' for unknown/not applicable.

id.name: gender_id
id.description: Primary key of the gender lookup table; referenced by superhero.gender_id to assign each superhero a gender.

table.name: hero_attribute
table.purpose: Junction table assigning numeric attribute scores (1-100) to superheroes, one row per hero per attribute (6 attributes: Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power, Combat). 623 heroes x 6 attributes = 3738 rows.

attribute_id.name: attribute_id
attribute_id.description: Foreign key to attribute.id, identifying which attribute (Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power, Combat) the score applies to. Each of the 6 attributes appears exactly 623 times (once per hero).

attribute_value.name: attribute_value
attribute_value.description: The hero's score for the given attribute, on a 1-100 scale (min 5, max 100, median 50).

hero_id.name: hero_id
hero_id.description: Foreign key to superhero.id, identifying the hero the attribute score belongs to. Each hero has 6 rows (one per attribute).

table.name: hero_power
table.purpose: Junction/association table linking superheroes to their superpowers (many-to-many between superhero and superpower). Each row records that a given hero has a given power; 5825 rows for 652 heroes and 167 distinct powers.

hero_id.name: hero_id
hero_id.description: Identifier of the superhero having the power; references superhero.id (many-to-one). Values range 1-756, matching the superhero table's ids.

power_id.name: power_id
power_id.description: Identifier of the superpower possessed by the hero; references superpower.id (many-to-one). Values range 1-167, matching the superpower table's ids.

table.name: publisher
table.purpose: Lookup table of comic/book/media publishers (or creators/rights holders) of superheroes, referenced by the superhero table.

id.name: publisher_id
id.description: Primary key; unique integer identifier for each publisher. Referenced by superhero.publisher_id (many superheroes to one publisher).

publisher_name.name: publisher_name
publisher_name.description: Unique name of the publisher/rights holder (e.g. 'DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics', 'Shueisha', 'Sony Pictures'). One row has an empty string, meaning unknown/unspecified publisher.

table.name: race
table.purpose: Lookup table of fictional species/races for superheroes (e.g. Alien, Mutant, Android, Vampire). Each row is one race; referenced by superhero.race_id.

id.name: race_id
id.description: Primary key; surrogate integer identifier for each race. Referenced by superhero.race_id.

race.name: race_name
race.description: Name of the fictional race/species (e.g. Alien, Mutant, Vampire, Inhuman). '-' appears to denote an unknown/unspecified race.

table.name: superhero
table.purpose: Catalog of 750 comic-book / fictional superheroes and villains, one row per character, with physical attributes (height, weight, eye/hair/skin colour), identity (full name, gender, race), alignment (good/bad/neutral) and publisher. Linked to superpowers and attributes via hero_power and hero_attribute junction tables.

alignment_id.name: alignment_id
alignment_id.description: FK to alignment lookup: 1=Good, 2=Bad, 3=Neutral (4=N/A in lookup, unused here). Character's moral alignment.

eye_colour_id.name: eye_colour_id
eye_colour_id.description: FK to colour lookup; the character's eye colour.

full_name.name: full_name
full_name.description: Character's civilian/legal full name (e.g. 'Bartholomew Allen II'). '-' (125 rows) and nulls indicate unknown identity.

hair_colour_id.name: hair_colour_id
hair_colour_id.description: FK to colour lookup; the character's hair colour.

height_cm.name: height_cm
height_cm.description: Character's height in centimetres. 0 (155 rows) and nulls mean unknown; extreme values (e.g. 10800, max 30480) are genuine for giant characters.

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; unique character identifier, referenced by hero_power.hero_id and hero_attribute.hero_id.

publisher_id.name: publisher_id
publisher_id.description: FK to publisher lookup (e.g. 4=DC Comics, 13 likely Marvel Comics given its dominance with 387 characters); the publisher/creator of the character.

race_id.name: race_id
race_id.description: FK to race lookup (e.g. 24 likely Human, 1 likely Human/- given frequency; 28=Human / Radiation, 34=Inhuman, 61=Zombie); the character's species/race.

skin_colour_id.name: skin_colour_id
skin_colour_id.description: FK to colour lookup; the character's skin colour. Value 1 (681 rows) is almost certainly a default such as '-' or the most common (normal human) skin tone.

superhero_name.name: superhero_name
superhero_name.description: Character's alias/costume name (e.g. 'Green Lantern V', 'Scorpia'); near-unique, a few names shared by different characters.

weight_kg.name: weight_kg
weight_kg.description: Character's weight in kilograms. 0 (172 rows) and nulls mean unknown; extreme values (e.g. 90000000) are genuine for giant/heavy characters.

table.name: superpower
table.purpose: Lookup table of superpowers/superhuman abilities; each row is one distinct power. Referenced by hero_power, which links superheroes to their powers.

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; surrogate identifier for each superpower. Referenced by hero_power.power_id to assign powers to superheroes.

power_name.name: power_name
power_name.description: Human-readable name of the superpower (e.g. 'Invisibility', 'Accelerated Healing', 'Animal Control'). Unique across all 167 rows.
